description:

The Italian GP 2026 heads to one of the fastest and most iconic circuits on the F1 calendar. At 5.793 km and 11 corners, Monza is all about straight-line speed, heavy braking and finding every possible advantage.

83% of the lap is spent flat-out, with more than half the lap distance above 300 km/h. Cars can reach around 348 km/h, while the biggest braking zone sees them drop from 347 km/h to just 73 km/h.
